screenpixvoices.us.title: Slaughter
screenpixvoices.us.description: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico. (Action) - 1972

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sitting Bull
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Top Gun
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Rick Martin (Sterling Hayden) goes back to his hometown to warn the townspeople of an imminent attack by marauders, he finds he has been exiled due to his reputation as a gunslinger for hire. Martin discovers that his late mother had been cheated out of her homestead by Canby Judd (William Bishop), who is now affianced to Martin's childhood sweetheart, Laura Mead (Karin Booth). Martin must clear his tarnished name, bring Judd to justice and save the town from the marauders. (Western) - 1955

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Terror in a Texas Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice. (Western) - 1958

When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. (Adventure, Action) - 2005

starzcomedy.us.title: Scary Movie 2
starzcomedy.us.description: All the scary movie characters are back in a laugh packed sequel that scares up even more irreverent fun than the original. Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris lead a stellar cast that takes extreme pleasure in skewering Hollywood's most frightening feature films and spoofing popular culture. Starring Regina Hall, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Tori Spelling and Tim Curry, Chris Elliott and James Woods, nothing's sacred and anything goes in this outlandish must-see comedy hit. (Comedy, Horror) - 2001

starzcomedy.us.title: Scary Movie 3

Local farmers Tom (Charlie Sheen) and George (Simon Rex) have reported massive crop circles appearing overnight in their fields. Cindy finds a link between the tape and the crop circles with help from the U.S. president (Leslie Nielsen) and a kindly aunt (Queen Latifah). (Comedy, Horror) - 2003

starzcomedy.us.title: The Lucky Ones

Poole (Michael Peña) decide to carpool to get to their far-off destinations. Colee wants to visit with her late fiancé's family, while wounded T.K. longs to see his future wife and Fred, needing fast cash to send his son to college, is headed for a casino. During the journey, the soldiers forge a bond based on their uncertain futures. (Drama) - 2008

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

skyadventure.uk.title: Addams Family Values

scifi.ca.description: S01 E10 Hide and Q Q gives superhuman powers to Riker and tells him his shipmates' wishes will be granted if he joins with Q.

scifi.ca.description: S01 E11 Haven Troi's mother (Majel Barrett) arrives to tell her daughter of marriage plans arranged by the counselor's late father.

scifi.ca.description: S03 E10 The Lucky Ones An act of kindness leads to obsession; Eva and Brice fall victim to a strange phenomenon.

tcm.ca.description: Clip of Judy Garland and Gene Kelly in For Me and My Gal; host George Murphy.

tcm.ca.title: Little Women
tcm.ca.description: Based on the story by Louisa May Alcott. The four March sisters forge unbreakable emotional ties during the Civil War.

skydrama.uk.title: The Breakfast Club (1985)
skydrama.uk.description: Five school kids - an athlete, a spoiled rich kid, a brainy nerd, an introverted loner and a rebellious punk - are brought together on a day-long detention where they break the rules, bare their souls and find they have more in common than just attending the same high school. (Comedy / Comedy drama) - 1985

skydrama.uk.title: Moneyball (2011)
skydrama.uk.description: Faced with a tight budget, a baseball manager and his partner recruit bargain bin players that scouts have labelled as flawed, but have game-winning potential. (Biography / Drama documentary / Drama) - 2011

skydrama.uk.title: Jerry Maguire (1996)
skydrama.uk.description: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes, finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money. (Drama / Romantic comedy) - 1996

skygreats.uk.title: Dog Day Afternoon (1975)
skygreats.uk.description: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation. (Crime drama / Gay/lesbian) - 1975

skygreats.uk.title: Jaws (1975)
skygreats.uk.description: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again. - 1975

skygreats.uk.title: Jaws 2 (1978)
skygreats.uk.description: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare. (Adventure / Horror / Thriller) - 1978

skythriller.uk.title: Murder by Numbers (2002)
skythriller.uk.description: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril. (Thriller) - 2002

skythriller.uk.title: Mulholland Drive (2001)
skythriller.uk.description: An actress bonds with an amnesiac in director David Lynch's surreal Hollywood tale. (Mystery / Thriller) - 2001

skythriller.uk.title: Caddo Lake (2024)
skythriller.uk.description: When an 8-year-old girl mysteriously vanishes, a series of past deaths and disappearances start to link together, forever altering a broken family's history. (Mystery / Thriller) - 2024
